name: TokenHub
install: [ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env; (cd backend && go mod download); (cd web && npm install)
start: sudo pg_ctlcluster 16 main start 2>/dev/null || true; sudo redis-server --daemonize yes 2>/dev/null || true; until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U tokenhub -d tokenhub >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; (cd backend && go run ./cmd/migrate)
